label: EU-mdr-2017 Article 104

obligations.text:
Support by the Commission
The Commission shall support the functioning of the cooperation between national competent authorities.

It shall, in particular, provide for the organisation of exchanges of experience between the competent authorities and provide technical, scientific and logistic support to the MDCG and its sub-groups.
It shall organise the meetings of the MDCG and its sub-groups, participate in those meetings and ensure the appropriate follow-up.
